slides.texte_overlay: spending the whole weekend half studying half feeling guilty for not studying enough

on friday i decide the ONE thing that really matters this weekend.
not ten. one.

one subject per study block.
switching back and forth was half my wasted time.

saturday morning, before the house wakes up.
the quietest 2 hours of my week.

every block ends with a 5-question mini-test.
if i pass it, i'm done. no guilt.

social apps off my home screen for the weekend.
fewer "quick checks", way more done.

and a plan for the fun part too.
guilt-free, because it's planned.
